address.description:
Owner wallet address (40-hex, 0x-prefixed). Same field name and
semantics across positions, balances, and activity.

counterparty_address.description:
Wallet of the other side of this trade, when known. `null` for
`order_type=taker` rows (the counterparty is the settlement venue,
not a user); for `order_type=maker` rows, the matching taker's wallet.
To resolve the taker leg, find the sibling row(s) in the same result
page with the same `transaction_hash` and `token_id` and opposite `side`.

fee.description:
Fee paid by this side of the trade, in USDC. Known data-quality issue:
the basis (`amount_usdc` vs `amount_shares`) is inconsistent across some
maker/taker pairs in the source data. Treat values with skepticism.

address.description:
Owner wallet address (40-hex, 0x-prefixed). Same field name and
semantics across positions, balances, and activity.

head_lag_seconds.description: Seconds between now and the head block — the data-freshness signal.

number.description: Canonical head block number (tombstoned orphans excluded).

last_priced_at.description:
RFC 3339 as-of time of the observed price behind `price_usd`: the
start of Goldsky's 60 s price bucket, or CoinGecko's own last update
when the price is CoinGecko's (the long-tail fallback). Never older than
the configured price window (default 4 h): an older price is not
served. **Null beside a non-null
`price_usd` means asserted at par (a tier-0 stablecoin, or a member of
one), not stale** — a `now - last_priced_at > threshold` filter must
exempt it or it drops every stablecoin. Null beside a null
`price_usd`: unpriced.

oneOf.description:
Solana rows only, with `include_chain_fields=true` and/or
`include_lamports=true`: fields EVM has no counterpart for, each flag
adding its own. Omitted otherwise.

total_value_usd.description:
Sum of `value_usd` over every balance that matches the request's
filters, across all pages. Balances without a USD value add nothing,
so read it as a lower bound. Null when `include_token_metadata` or
`include_prices` is false.

last_priced_at.description:
As on a balance: the observation behind `price_usd`. **Null beside a
non-null `price_usd` means asserted at par (a tier-0 stablecoin, or a
member of one), not stale.**

price_usd.description:
Current USD price, by the rule `/feeds/wallets/balances` prices a
balance with. Null when Goldsky has no price source for the token or
no observation inside the price window.

data.description:
One item per distinct requested token, in request order. A token
Goldsky knows nothing about is still listed, with null metadata and
price.

log_index.description:
EVM `erc20` rows only, with `include_position=true`: the log index of
the transfer event in its block. Omitted otherwise.

oneOf.description:
Solana rows only, with `include_chain_fields=true`: fields EVM has no
counterpart for. Omitted otherwise.

trace_address.description:
EVM `native` rows only, with `include_position=true`: the trace
address of the call, comma-joined (`""` for the top-level call).
Omitted otherwise.

next_page_token.description: Pass back as `page_token` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

prev_page_token.description:
Pass back as `page_token` for the previous page; `null` on the first
page. Going back re-reads the rows, so a row that changed position
since (a balance whose value moved) can appear on a different page.

address.description:
Owner wallet address (40-hex, 0x-prefixed). Same field name and
semantics across positions, balances, and activity.

last_updated_at.description:
Pipeline upsert time (seconds, microsecond precision). Not the on-chain
block timestamp — two rows with different `block_number` can share this
value when upserted in the same pipeline batch.

SolanaBalanceFields.description: Solana-only fields of a balance. Omitted on EVM rows.

lamports.description:
With `include_lamports=true`: the lamports held in the token accounts
covered (`lamports_account_count` of them), as a decimal string: their
rent, plus the wrapped SOL of wSOL accounts (for wSOL, rent = lamports
minus `balance_raw`, which already counts the wrapped SOL). On native
SOL only with `include_rent=true`: the rent of the wallet's token
accounts covered, already added to its `balance_raw`.

lamports_account_count.description:
With `include_lamports=true`: how many token accounts `lamports`
covers: the largest by token amount first, so empty accounts come last
(at most 10 per balance, 20 per request, ~3 s on ODB). Fewer than
`open_account_count` means `lamports` is partial; with none covered
(the request's cap used up, or the lookup failed), `lamports` is
omitted. On native SOL with `include_rent=true`: the first 20 of the
wallet's token accounts by address.

open_account_count.description:
With `include_lamports=true`: every open token account of this mint,
empty (rent-only) ones included. With the flag, a mint whose balance
is 0 but that still has an open account is returned too (its rent is
held now); fully closed mints still need `include_historical`. On
native SOL with `include_rent=true`: every open token account of the
wallet, absent when the lookup failed.

token_account_count.description:
With `include_chain_fields=true`. How many of the wallet's token
accounts the balance sums over (a wallet may own several for one
mint): every open account with a non-zero amount.

token_accounts.description:
The largest of those accounts, largest first (ties by address), at
most 10. Fewer entries than `token_account_count` means the list was
cut. Native SOL sits in the wallet's own account, so its one entry is
the wallet itself. With `include_chain_fields=true`.

SolanaTokenAccount.description: One of the wallet's token accounts behind a balance.

balance_raw.description: Its amount in the mint's base units, as a decimal string.

lamports.description:
With `include_lamports=true` too: the lamports at this account, if
the request's lookup covered it.

SolanaTransferFields.description:
Solana-only fields of a transfer, beside the shared ones. Omitted on EVM
rows.

authority.description:
Who authorised the movement when it was not the sender: a delegate,
the mint authority, … Null when the sender signed.

counterparty_token_account.description:
The other side's token account; null on native rows and on mint /
burn legs.

fee_amount_raw.description:
Token-2022 withheld transfer fee in the token's smallest unit; null
means unknown, not zero. `amount_raw` is gross: the recipient is
credited `amount_raw - fee_amount_raw`.

instruction.description:
The instruction as the dataset names it (`TransferChecked`,
`SplTransfer`, `Transfer`, `MintTo`, `Burn`, `CreateAccount`, …).

token_account.description:
The wallet's own token account on this row; the wallet itself on a
native row. Null on an SPL row without one.

X402PaymentRequired.description: x402 v2 payment challenge. Pick one `accepts` entry, sign a USDC payment for its `amount`, and retry with it attached.

accepts.description: One entry per network and asset Circle Gateway can settle.

amount.description: Atomic USDC to authorize: a prepaid top-up (5000 = $0.005) that later requests spend down.

extra.description: Scheme-specific data, e.g. `name: GatewayWalletBatched` and the `verifyingContract` to sign against.

maxTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the authorization may stay valid.

api_key.description: Feeds API key, from app.goldsky.com → Feeds → API keys (also accepted: `?key=` or `Authorization: Bearer`).
api_key.name: x-api-key

info.description:
Goldsky Feeds: onchain data over REST. Formerly Edge Data / Data APIs; existing URLs and keys keep working.

- **Wallet feeds**: one wallet's token transfers or balances across chains, with USD values (`/feeds/wallets/transfers`, `/feeds/wallets/balances`).
- **Tokens**: metadata and current USD price for up to 100 `chain:token_address` pairs per request (`/feeds/tokens`).
- **Prediction markets** (Polymarket, on Polygon): Activity, Positions and Balances (`/polymarket/*`).
- **Chain datasets**: Blocks and Chain head for each supported chain (`/blocks/{chain}`, `/blocks/{chain}/head`).

Base URL: `https://edge.goldsky.com/data`. Every endpoint is a `GET` that returns JSON.

## Authentication

Send your Feeds API key in the `x-api-key` header, as the `?key=` query parameter, or as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Get it at [app.goldsky.com](https://app.goldsky.com) under **Feeds → API keys**. One key works for every endpoint; an invalid key gets `401`.

## Billing

Requests made with a key bill compute units (CUs) at $10 per million:

- Wallet feeds and Tokens: 35 CUs per request.
- Prediction markets and Chain datasets: 1 CU per row returned. Chain head is 1 CU per call.

Errors are not billed, and a Prediction markets or Chain datasets request that returns no rows costs nothing. Rate limits are set per plan (`429` when exceeded); Goldsky support can raise them.

## Pay per request with x402

No account or key needed. A request without a key gets `402` with an x402 v2 challenge in the `PAYMENT-REQUIRED` header (base64 JSON; the body carries the same challenge). Pay in USDC through Circle Gateway and retry. Each payment is a $0.005 prepaid top-up, tied to the paying wallet and shared with Edge RPC, that later requests spend down:

- Wallet feeds and Tokens: $0.00035 (350 atomic USDC) per request.
- Prediction markets and Chain datasets: $0.00001 (10 atomic USDC) per request, whatever the row count.

The payment flow is in [x402 nanopayments](https://docs.goldsky.com/edge-rpc/capabilities/x402).

get.description: The latest balance of every token one wallet holds across chains, EVM natives included, with USD value and the wallet's total.

parameters.description: The one wallet this request is about. Required.
parameters.name: address

parameters.description: Comma-separated canonical chain slugs; default all. Supported: `solana`, `arbitrum_one`, `arc`, `base`, `bsc`, `ethereum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `robinhood`.
parameters.name: chains

parameters.description: Comma-separated token contracts; the zero address selects natives. On a Solana wallet: mints (base58); native SOL is `So11111111111111111111111111111111111111111`.
parameters.name: token_address

parameters.description:
Comma-separated symbols, matched case-insensitively against the
served `token_symbol` (token metadata first, else the registry).
Conflicts with `include_token_metadata=false` (422).
parameters.name: token_symbol

parameters.description:
Default false: hide tokens Goldsky has no price source for (neither
tier-0 nor a canonical registry member). Such a token may still be
served unpriced when included; a priceable one may lack a price.
parameters.name: include_unknown_price

parameters.description:
Dust filter on `value_usd`: rows below it are dropped, and so are
unpriced rows (no value clears any threshold). Applies to
`total_value_usd` too. Conflicts with `include_token_metadata=false`
and `include_prices=false` (422).
parameters.name: min_value_usd

parameters.description:
Also return zero balances: fully sold tokens, and natives the wallet
holds none of. Default false.
parameters.name: include_historical

parameters.description:
Default true. False skips the token metadata read and serves
`token_symbol`, `token_name`, `token_decimals` and `token_logo_url`
null, so `value_usd` and `total_value_usd` are null too. Conflicts
with `token_symbol` and `min_value_usd` (422).
parameters.name: include_token_metadata

parameters.description:
Default true. False skips the price reads and serves `price_usd`,
`last_priced_at`, `value_usd` and `total_value_usd` null. Conflicts
with `min_value_usd` (422).
parameters.name: include_prices

parameters.description: Default 100, max 1000.
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description:
`pagination.next_page_token` (or `prev_page_token`) from a previous
response.
parameters.name: page_token

parameters.description: Solana only: `true` adds the chain-specific fields of the `solana` object to each Solana item. Default `false`. Ignored on an EVM wallet.
parameters.name: include_chain_fields

parameters.description: Solana only: `true` adds `solana.lamports`, the lamports held in the wallet's token accounts of each mint (their rent; wrapped SOL too for wSOL), with `lamports_account_count` (accounts covered: the largest by token amount, 10 per balance, 20 per request; fewer than `open_account_count` means partial) and `open_account_count`. Also returns zero-balance tokens that still have an open (rent-only) account (fully closed ones need `include_historical`); in the page-token fingerprint when on. For wSOL the lamports include the wrapped SOL. One more query; a failed lookup covers nothing rather than failing the page. Default `false`. Ignored on an EVM wallet.
parameters.name: include_lamports

parameters.description: Solana only: `true` adds the rent held in the wallet's open token accounts (the lamports at each; for wSOL less the wrapped SOL) to native SOL's `balance_raw` and `value_usd`, and to `total_value_usd`. Native SOL's `solana` object then gives `lamports` (the rent added), `lamports_account_count` (accounts covered: the first 20 by address) and `open_account_count` (all open token accounts); fewer covered than open means partial. Two more queries; a failed lookup adds nothing rather than failing the page. In the page-token fingerprint when on. Default `false`. Ignored on an EVM wallet.
parameters.name: include_rent

401.description: Invalid API key (sent as `x-api-key`, `?key=` or `Authorization: Bearer`). Empty body; never billed. A request with no key gets `402` instead.

402.description: Payment required — the body is an x402 challenge; `accepts[].amount` names the price in the settlement asset's atomic units.

422.description: Conflicting filters, or `QUERY_TOO_BROAD`: do not retry unchanged; set `token_address` or leave `include_unknown_price` off (`error.suggested_params`)

429.description: Rate limited: over the request rate for this key's plan. Empty body. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds; Goldsky support can raise the limit. Never billed.

503.description: Native balances unavailable on the chains named in `error.chains`; retry after `Retry-After` seconds. Or `QUERY_TIMEOUT`: retry after `Retry-After` seconds; if it times out again, set `token_address` or leave `include_unknown_price` off. Or `UPSTREAM_BUSY`: retry the same request after `Retry-After` seconds Or: Solana data unavailable: `SOLANA_UNAVAILABLE` (Obsession DB overloaded or unreachable), `SOLANA_READ_LIMIT` (a read limit), `SOLANA_SCAN_FAILED` (transfers: the narrowest scan window could not complete). The first two carry `error.reason`: `concurrency_limit`, `quota`, `overloaded`, `price_unavailable`, `unresponsive`, `query_failed`; `query_timeout`, `request_deadline`, `read_limit`. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds.
